mapper.select: SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.password, T.enabled, R.authority, UO.ORGANIZATION_ID AS orgId, T.tenantId AS tenantId, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES UR ON UR.userid = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = UR.authority AND R.enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON UO.userid = T.username WHERE T.username = #{username}

SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.password, T.enabled, R.authority, UO.ORGANIZATION_ID AS orgid, T.tenantId, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES UR ON UR.userid = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = UR.authority AND R.enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON UO.userid = T.username WHERE T.mobile = #{mobile}
SELECT U.username, U.nickname FROM LA_USER_ROLES UR INNER JOIN LA_USERS U ON U.USERNAME = UR.USERID AND UR.AUTHORITY = #{roleId}
